review.title: Confirm cleanup
review.empty.title: Nothing selected
review.disabled.cleanup: Cleanup is turned off on this NAS
review.recycle.title: Items move to their shared folder's Recycle Bin
review.recycle.body: Nothing is deleted for good. Restore the items or empty the Recycle Bin in DSM; the space is freed only after it is emptied
review.recycle.restore: To undo, open #recycle in the shared folder in File Station, select the items and choose Restore
review.recycle.olderDsm: DSM before 7.2.1 has no Restore button: move the items out of #recycle in File Station
review.recycle.sync: In a folder that Synology Drive, ShareSync or Cloud Sync syncs, the move also removes the items from the synced copies
review.numbers.title: Cleanup summary
review.numbers.allocated: Sizes are the space the items use now. The volume gets it back only after the Recycle Bin is emptied, and snapshots or shared data can keep some of it

review.willMove.one: Will move to Recycle Bin: {count} item, {bytes}; empty the share's Recycle Bin to free about {free}
review.willMove.other: Will move to Recycle Bin: {count} items, {bytes}; empty the share's Recycle Bin to free about {free}

review.willMoveOnly.one: Will move to Recycle Bin: {count} item, {bytes}
review.willMoveOnly.other: Will move to Recycle Bin: {count} items, {bytes}

review.confirmCheck: I understand the items move to the Recycle Bin and the space is freed only after emptying it
review.share.title: Shared folder {share}
review.share.adminOnly: Only administrators can see and restore these items in the Recycle Bin
review.share.everyone: Everyone who can open {share} can see and restore these items in its Recycle Bin
review.share.drive: Some items are in Synology Drive folders: computers that sync those folders lose them too
review.refusal.cleanupDisabled: Cleanup is turned off on this NAS
review.refusal.busy: Another scan or cleanup is using this volume. Recheck when it finishes
review.refusal.targetChanged: Changed since the last scan. Scan again or remove it from the list
review.refusal.changed: The plan expired or no longer matches. Recheck before continuing
review.refusal.inRecycleBin: Already in a Recycle Bin. Syno Reclaim never removes anything from a Recycle Bin; empty it in DSM
review.refusal.boundary: A Btrfs subvolume, or on another volume. Remove it and select the items inside instead
review.refusal.outsideRoots: Outside the folders cleanup may change. Remove it from the list
review.refusal.recycleBinUnavailable: DSM's Recycle Bin service isn't available right now, so nothing moved. Try again later
review.refusal.untrustedState: Cleanup records failed a safety check, so nothing moved. Download a support bundle in Settings > Diagnostics and contact support
review.refusal.ioError: A read or write error stopped cleanup. Check the drives in Storage Manager
review.refusal.duplicatesStale: The duplicate results are older than the latest scan. Open Duplicates, analyze again, then reselect
review.refusal.duplicatesUnknownGroup: A selected duplicate group no longer exists. Open Duplicates and reselect
review.refusal.keeperChanged: A copy that was to be kept changed or went missing, so nothing moved. Scan again and find duplicates again, then reselect
review.refusal.keeperRemoved: Together, the selected duplicates would leave no copy of some file, so nothing moved. Remove a group from the list, or keep one more copy
review.refusal.keeperConflict: A selected group would remove a copy you chose to keep in another group, so nothing moved. Remove one of the groups from the list, or keep another copy
review.refusal.keeperConflictNamed: {copy} is kept in “{kept}”, but removing “{removing}” would remove it, so nothing moved. Remove one of the two groups from the list, or keep another copy
review.refusal.duplicatesNothing: The selected duplicates no longer move anything. Remove them from the list
review.refusal.other: Cleanup was refused. Recheck the selected items
review.applying.title: Moving to Recycle Bin
review.applying.pollError: Can't read progress right now. Still checking; cleanup won't be sent again
review.applying.cancelError: Couldn't cancel; cleanup may still be running
review.result.title: Cleanup result
review.result.moved: Moved to Recycle Bin: {bytes}; space is freed after emptying it
review.result.empty: Empty it in Control Panel > Shared Folder > Action > Empty Recycle Bin, or with a Recycle Bin task in Task Scheduler
review.applyError.noRetry: Check the job status before starting another cleanup; this screen won't send it again

review.recycle.time: Big moves take time: DSM moves about a few thousand files per second, and the space is freed only after the Recycle Bin is emptied
review.duplicates.scanAge: These results come from the scan of {time}. Files added to or changed in the copies being moved since then go to the Recycle Bin too, where they can be restored. If those folders may have changed, scan again first
review.duplicates.scanAgeDelete: These results come from the scan of {time}. Files added to or changed in the copies being removed since then are removed with them: to the Recycle Bin, or for good where there is none. If those folders may have changed, scan again first
review.protected.recycle_bin: Already in a Recycle Bin: empty it in DSM
review.protected.package: Data of a DSM package: free its space in that package
review.protected.packageNamed: Data of {package}: free its space in {package}
review.protected.share_root: A shared folder itself: select items inside it
review.protected.home: A user home: select items inside it
review.protected.outside_share: Not in a DSM shared folder: cleanup moves items only into a shared folder's Recycle Bin

review.confirmCheckDeleteOnly.other: I understand {deletes} items are deleted for good and cannot be restored

review.delete.body: No Recycle Bin can take them: they are in no DSM shared folder, or in a shared folder whose Recycle Bin is off. Reclaim deletes them, and they cannot be restored
review.delete.share: Not in a DSM shared folder: the items in {share} are deleted for good
review.delete.binOff: {share} has no Recycle Bin turned on: its items are deleted for good
review.delete.binOffEnable: To be able to restore them, turn its Recycle Bin on first, then select Recheck: they then move to the Recycle Bin instead
review.refusal.deleteNotConfirmed: This plan deletes items with no Recycle Bin for good: confirm that to go on
review.applying.titleMixed: Moving to Recycle Bin and deleting for good

review.result.cancelledCounts.one: Cancelled: {done} done, {left} item not handled and left as it was
review.result.cancelledCounts.other: Cancelled: {done} done, {left} items not handled and left as they were

review.result.cancelTooLate: Cancel came while the last item was being handled, so it finished

review.recycle.syncDelete: In a folder that Synology Drive, ShareSync or Cloud Sync syncs, deleting also removes the items from the synced copies
review.refusal.notFound: This item is no longer there. Remove it from the cleanup list

review.recycle.symlinks.other: {symlinks} shortcuts (symlinks) among them are not kept by DSM's Recycle Bin and do not come back on restore
